correctness.rationale: Exact eligible-zero formula e(T)=r_1(q-c)+(p-r)c_1, sparse-defender bound with strict cases p>=4, explicit p=2,3 exceptions, and a dense-equality row/column rigidity argument prove the statement for all 2<=p<=q. originality.rationale: The 2022 complete full-text Cartesian-product paper treats products of paths/cycles, not complete graphs. A 2020 general inequality yields the already-known upper bound 2p but not the sharp lower bound or all minimizers; the 2018 regular-graph analysis is likewise general. Public record queries for line-graph and rook-graph aliases did not reveal the exact classification. Priority is subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
residual_risks: Unindexed or differently named graph-class results could already imply the same all-minimizer classification.
The exact weight 2p upper bound was previously implied by general inequalities and cannot alone support a novelty claim.
